summary: Every aerial on Commons (2009-2012) predates or shows the 2011-13 rebuild, so none shows the current bowl. Day: 2016 empty view from the west end zone stands of the rebuilt stadium, looking out the open east end. No qualifying night photo.

files.author: Atomic Taco
files.credit_line: Photo: Atomic Taco / CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
files.note: Mid-level west end zone seats looking east down the empty field between the two roofed sidelines toward the open end and scoreboard; field in the middle, roughly rows 840-1100, empty bleachers fill the bottom third and grey sky the top quarter.

closest_misses.why: High-quality aerial but taken mid-rebuild (south side under construction); not the current stadium.
2009 elevated game panorama of the pre-rebuild bowl (running track, old lower bowl).
